newsitem.title: USA: Miami police rush to possible Cunanan sighting.
newsitem.headline: Miami police rush to possible Cunanan sighting.

text.p: Police rushed to a houseboat moored on Miami Beach on Wednesday after at least one shot was fired at a caretaker by a man barricaded inside, a police spokesman said.
Local television said police believed Andrew Cunanan, the alleged killer of fashion designer Gianni Versace, could be the man inside the houseboat.

"We just have a shot fired call," said Bernie Ruder, spokesman for the Miami Beach Police Department, who said he could not immediately confirm television reports that the caretaker, or possibly the boat's owner, had described the man who fired from the houseboat as resembling Cunanan.
"I don't have any other information on it other than that a shot was fired," he said. "We believe there is a subject barricaded inside."
Dozens of police rushed to the scene and cordoned off streets and the waterway surrounding the houseboat, located about 40 blocks from where Versace was killed on July 15.
